text:
Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring your Veloce for my daughter's wedding, and I would be grateful if you could confirm the details. We plan to collect the vehicle on 22/03/2027 at 12:00 and return it on Tuesday 23 March 2027 at 12:30 pm. As agreed, we will pick it up from your garage. According to your website, the total cost comes to EUR 944.00. I have also included a copy of my driving licence for your records.

Best wishes,
Cora Thistlewood +70 622 618 7774
